section3: Sub‑4% 10Y continues to underpin duration‑sensitive risk while a firmer dollar and a sharp WTI rebound complicate the inflation path. Index‑level tape will hinge on a dense mega‑cap earnings cluster (Wed–Thu), with dispersion likely around AI, advertising, and cloud trends. Housing prints today and consumer sentiment tomorrow frame demand; GDP (Thu) and the FOMC (Wed) set the macro tone into month‑end. Key risks: shutdown‑related data gaps, oil volatility, and a stronger DXY tightening financial conditions.
